description:
One venue's seating layout from UPFRONT's 3D model of it: every
section by level, where each sits, how far its front and back are
from the field, court or stage (distanceFt: [front, back]), how high
they sit (heightFt: [front, back]), whether it's covered (a deck or
roof overhead reaching well past the seats; wind can still blow rain
in), the sections next to it, and its page. Matches questions like
"how is the upper level at Lumen Field laid out?" or "which sections
at MetLife are covered?". One venue per answer, with no row or seat
counts.

venue: the venue's name ("Madison Square Garden", "MSG", "Lumen
Field").
level: optional; one level only ("300 Level", "Upper Level").

Covers the venues with an UPFRONT seating chart; for any other venue
the answer says so and lists the ones covered.
name: get_venue_layout
title: Venue seating layout
